thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: Prod inference pool (inference-pool-east-1) p95 latency spike observed across multiple models · alert routed to oncall (maria_sre). Autoscale triggered but latency persists. 

maria_sre: I'm on it. Starting initial triage — grabbing p95/p50 trends and recent deploys. Paging chao_infra for kernel/perf counters.

chao_infra: ACK. Pulling perf counters (sched, page-faults, CPU steal) and latest dmesg. If this is paging, we'll see elevated pgmajfaults / swap activity.

alex_prod: Noted increased customer error surface reported by Support. Sam, can you collect example request ids and regions impacted?

sam_support: Yep — collecting customer request ids and a few complaint threads. Looks like 2 enterprise customers in eu-west-1 and us-east-1 reported timeouts (~10-15s). I pasted 3 request ids: req_8f3a, req_8f3b, req_8f3c.

maria_sre: Quick snapshot: p50 from 45ms -> 90ms, p95 from 180ms -> 1.9s in the last 7m for text-gen endpoints. Token throughput steady. Suggest we capture a trace for a slow request (req_8f3a).

chao_infra: Shared a minimal trace snippet: ```trace_id: trace-0x7a9, spans: [recv->scheduler wait 1200ms, kernel-sched 800ms, model-exec 300ms]``` Looks like scheduling stalls. Also past 2 samples show pgmajfault count increase on node gpu-12.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: Active mitigation options: 1) scale up dedicated nodes in pool (fast) 2) roll back recent kernel patch (unsafe until confirmed) 3) switch routing to lower-memory model variant (possible quick fallback).

maria_sre: Prioritize mitigation 1 + 3. Chao please check if kernel patch landed in the last deploy window on gpu-12 host images. If yes, prepare rollback plan. I'll open an RCF (runbook checklist) in the ops channel.

chao_infra: Checking image history... yes, kernel 5.15.84 -> 5.15.98 rolled to a subset of nodes at 02:10 UTC (approx 25m ago). Rollout was 15% canary. gpu-12 is on 5.15.98. I pulled perf counters: 
- cpu.context_switches: +40% 
- pgmajfault: +120% 
- softirqs: unchanged 
- vmstat pgfault: spike correlates with tail latencies.

alex_prod: Hmm. Hypothesis A: kernel scheduling change causing inflight context switch stalls under our continuous batching pattern -> p95 regress. Hypothesis B: unrelated memory leak in model process causing swapping. Need logs from model process to confirm.

maria_sre: Chao — can you collect `perf sched` and `sudo bpftrace` snippet from gpu-12? If we confirm scheduler stalls, we'll mark kernel as likely. If model oom/alloc fails, then model-level.

chao_infra: Pasting short bpftrace output (truncated): ```
# bpftrace snippet
kprobe:context_switch /pid == 2387/ { @[comm] = hist(nsecs - @start); }
=>  scheduler hist: high tail at ~800ms for process "model_runner"
```

maria_sre: Good data. Sam — can you check if model_runner logs contain repeated GC/alloc or if OOM kills logged around the same timeframe?

sam_support: Model logs (excerpt): "2026-03-17T02:14:05Z model_runner[2387]: warn: slow vmalloc: 462ms alloc; 02:14:06 kernel: some OOM helpers not triggered;" No kill events. Memory usage per container stable at ~12GB, host has 2GB free -> swap usage increased.

alex_prod: So memory pressure + kernel scheduling change both present. We should treat this as compound: kernel change exacerbating page reclaim latency bringing model into stall. Mitigations: (A) temporarily route a % of traffic to smaller model variant (less mem), (B) scale pool to add nodes that still run older kernel, (C) accelerate kernel rollback for canary.

maria_sre: Executing mitigation A now: switching 30% of traffic to model-quant-small for latency-sensitive routes. Applying via routing policy.

incident-bot: ACTION: routing-policy updated — 30% shifted to model-quant-small for /v1/generate for affected customers.

chao_infra: Kicking off node scale: +6 nodes (older-image) to the inference pool. Should be live in ~2m. Also preparing rollback plan for 5.15.98 canary nodes; will not auto-rollback unless we confirm correlation.

sam_support: Customer update queued: "We are seeing an elevated latency on inference in some regions. We are mitigating by shifting traffic and scaling capacity. Expect improvement within 10 minutes. Apologize for disruption"

maria_sre: Adding timeline notes for RCA: 
- 02:05 UTC: kernel patch rolled to subset (canary)
- 02:10-02:20 UTC: p95 climbs, pgmajfault increases on canary hosts
- 02:14 UTC: customer timeouts reported (req_8f3a..c)
- 02:18 UTC: traffic re-routing + scale started
- 02:22 UTC: observed p95 heading down to ~600ms after routing + new nodes join

chao_infra: Perf counters post-mitigation: pgmajfault down 70% on affected hosts, context_switches back closer to baseline. No further OOMs.

alex_prod: From a customer-impact perspective: 2 enterprise customers had elevated tail latency/timeouts for ~12-18 minutes. No data loss. Recommend we prepare a post-incident customer note with timeline and mitigation steps.

maria_sre: Agreed. I'll own postmortem and fill in timeline + hypothesis testing steps. Next: collect full perf samples (perf sched + ftrace) for the canary nodes and rollback plan logs. Chao, can you attach the dmesg and kernel boot logs to the incident doc?

chao_infra: Attaching links: https://internal.gist/gpu-12-dmesg-1880012345, https://internal.gist/perf-sched-sample-1880012345 

incident-bot: HANDOFF: paging-rca thread handed to oncall-next (maria_sre -> chao_infra) for overnight follow-up. Please include A/B test of kernel revert on one node and re-run the same load.

maria_sre: Handoff acknowledged. Next oncall please run controlled revert + perf run and post results to this thread. Closing active paging mitigation — monitoring for regressions. :white_check_mark:
